description: Jinhai Industrial Co., Ltd. is incorporated in Suzhou, Mainland China. Since 15 March 2018 it has held 100% of Jinhai Asia Limited, a Hong Kong company, for which it paid HKD 2,000,000. On 1 September 2026 Jinhai Asia reduced its share capital and returned HKD 3,000,000 to Jinhai Industrial. No tax has been paid on the distribution. We have the board resolution and the special resolution approving the reduction, the audited accounts of Jinhai Asia for 2025 and the bank remittance advice. Please assess as at 20 October 2026; all amounts in HKD.
